summary: Create one UGE International Inc. U.S. community-solar and storage platform, preserving UGE International Ltd. and its tickers as predecessor aliases. NOVA Fund II's take-private closed on August 15, 2024, NOVA-Swift Holdco is the sole direct shareholder, and no later platform transfer or pending sale was found.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Exact Fund II and rollover-holder economics, governance and later LP-unit transfers are not publicly disclosed.
Exact current 2026 operating MW, complete subsidiary roster and 2008-versus-2010 origin-year discrepancy remain noncritical disclosure gaps.
recommendedActions: Create one canonical UGE International Inc. company in the United States.
Preserve UGE International Ltd., UGE, TSXV:UGE and OTCQB:UGEIF as predecessor aliases.
Add NOVA Infrastructure as the active owner from August 15, 2024 through NOVA Infrastructure Fund II and NOVA-Swift Holdco, LP.
Exclude project SPVs, rollover holders, tax-equity vehicles, lenders and OYA development rights as separate PortCos or direct owners.
